title: Glowing pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura behind scissors -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="40" ry="35" fill="#1a2a3a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="30" ry="26" fill="#2a4a5a" opacity="0.4"/>
  <!-- left blade -->
  <path d="M48 46 L18 18 Q14 14 12 18 Q10 22 14 26 L44 50 Z" fill="#7ee8fa" stroke="#a8f0ff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M46 47 L22 22" stroke="#d0faff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- right blade -->
  <path d="M52 46 L82 18 Q86 14 88 18 Q90 22 86 26 L56 50 Z" fill="#8af0ff" stroke="#b0f5ff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M54 47 L78 22" stroke="#d0faff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.8"/>
  <!-- pivot screw -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="4" fill="#ffe066" stroke="#fff0a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#fff8cc"/>
  <!-- left handle -->
  <path d="M46 52 Q38 60 32 72 Q28 82 34 86 Q40 90 46 84 Q52 78 54 66 Q56 58 52 52 Z" fill="#ff6b9d" stroke="#ff9ec4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="72" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#1a2a3a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- right handle -->
  <path d="M54 52 Q62 60 68 72 Q72 82 66 86 Q60 90 54 84 Q48 78 46 66 Q44 58 48 52 Z" fill="#ffa64d" stroke="#ffcc80" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="72" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#1a2a3a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <!-- glow highlights on blades -->
  <path d="M30 30 L20 20" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M70 30 L80 20" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9">
    <polygon points="12,10 13,14 17,15 13,16 12,20 11,16 7,15 11,14"/>
    <polygon points="88,8 89,12 93,13 89,14 88,18 87,14 83,13 87,12"/>
    <polygon points="10,52 11,55 14,56 11,57 10,60 9,57 6,56 9,55"/>
    <polygon points="90,50 91,53 94,54 91,55 90,58 89,55 86,54 89,53"/>
  </g>
</svg>
